incidents.name: Incident on 2013-10-03 09:35:17 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2013-10-03 09:35:17 - The site is unavailable as we investigate issues reaching GitHub.com.
  • 2013-10-03 09:43:40 - We are recovering from a major service outage as we work to mitigate another DDoS attack.
  • 2013-10-03 10:17:12 - Service hook delivery is delayed and archived generation unavailable while the attack continues. We're simultaneously working on deflecting the attack and restoring affected services.
  • 2013-10-03 10:20:58 - The site is unavailable as we continue mitigating a large DDoS attack.
  • 2013-10-03 10:48:43 - We're working to re-establish connectivity after the attack disrupted our primary internet transit links.
  • 2013-10-03 11:15:26 - Transit connectivity has been restored for some users. We are still actively mitigating a large attack.
  • 2013-10-03 11:31:10 - We've restored access to code downloads and queued service hooks are being delivered. The attack continues, but our mitigation is holding firm.
  • 2013-10-03 12:35:15 - The attack has subsided and services have recovered. We're keeping mitigation in place to ensure we're able to quickly react if the attack returns.
